UserAuditProfile.title: UserAuditProfile
UserAuditProfile.description: Synchronized institutional identity audit record linking a verified Firebase Authentication UID to its SQLite application profile ID and role.

uid.description: Verified Firebase Authentication UID matching request.auth.uid.

sqliteUserId.description: Primary key in SQLite users table (e.g., USR-ADMIN-01, USR-FAC-101, USR-STU-001).

displayName.description: Full institutional display name of the user.

department.description: Assigned academic department or governance unit.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent verified authentication.

AdminRegistryEntry.title: AdminRegistryEntry
AdminRegistryEntry.description: Trusted Firestore admin membership marker keyed by Firebase UID.

/user_audit_profiles/{userId}.description: Stores non-PII institutional identity audit metadata per verified Firebase UID; primary roles and academic records reside in SQLite.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Stores verified administrator UIDs for ABAC checks.
